card.name: Linking words in antibiotic name lists
card.fires_on: Commas, "and" and "such as" that come right before the next antibiotic name in a list of antibiotics, such as streptomycin, tetracycline, kanamycin or neomycin.

modes.label: Comma between antibiotics
modes.description: A comma after one antibiotic name, where another antibiotic name is expected next.
modes.example: Antibiotics such as rifampicin, tetracycline<<,>> streptomycin and getnamicin

modes.label: "and" or "such as" before antibiotics
modes.description: The linking word that introduces or finishes a list of antibiotics.
modes.example: Bacteriostatic antibiotics: Bacteriostatic antibiotics, such<< as>> tetracycline, erythrom

card.plain: It fires on the small words in a list of antibiotics, just before the next antibiotic name is written.
